description: A hospital staffing coordinator must assign the only available float registered nurse for an evening shift between the oncology and cardiac step-down units and finalize coverage for the unit that does not receive the float.

shared_context.S1: The oncology unit and cardiac step-down unit both need additional registered-nurse coverage for tonight.
shared_context.S2: One float registered nurse is available for assignment, and Morgan makes the binding staffing call.
shared_context.S3: Both units have scheduled patient-care activities during the evening that require their usual staffing plans to be reviewed.
shared_context.S4: The hospital's evening staffing huddle routinely includes the charge nurses and HR staffing before the assignment is finalized.

PF1.text: The oncology unit has a vesicant infusion scheduled from 21:00 to 22:30, and hospital policy requires a chemotherapy-credentialed RN at the bedside for that infusion; the available float RN is the only credentialed RN who can cover it tonight.

PF2.text: The cardiac step-down unit's assigned nurse must escort a patient off the unit from 20:00 to 21:00, but the ICU charge nurse has confirmed that an ICU RN can provide a one-hour buddy coverage assignment for cardiac step-down during that escort.

PF3.text: The float RN's staffing agreement permits work tonight only from 19:00 through 23:00 and requires release at 23:00 because of a previously scheduled assignment at another facility.

acceptance_conditions: The float RN must be assigned to oncology for tonight.
The float RN's assignment must run from 19:00 through 23:00.
The oncology vesicant infusion must have chemotherapy-credentialed RN coverage.
The cardiac step-down escort must have ICU RN buddy coverage from 20:00 through 21:00.
The cardiac buddy coverage must be recorded as a staffing commitment.
The chemotherapy-credentialing fact must be cited as justification for assigning the float to oncology.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'buddy_coverage' and c['target'] == 'cardiac_step_down' and c['detail'] == 'ICU RN from 20:00 to 21:00' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The 21:00-22:30 vesicant infusion and the float's unique chemotherapy credential change the float assignment to oncology and require documented chemotherapy-credentialed coverage.
The 20:00-21:00 escort removes the cardiac nurse from the unit, while the confirmed ICU RN changes cardiac coverage from unspecified to a documented one-hour buddy assignment.
The staffing agreement changes the float schedule to exactly 19:00-23:00 rather than an unspecified evening assignment or a shift extending past 23:00.
